summary: Frontend-only regression on TransLog admin: uppercase-auto inputs, DOURADOS/MS defaults, back button/session persistence and public tracking. All requested behaviors verified on mobile viewport (390x844).

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for DialogContent (Radix a11y warning) - not blocking, but should add DialogDescription.

action_items: (Optional) add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to EntregaFormDialog and MovimentacaoDialog to silence Radix a11y warning.

(Optional) Consider showing destinatário name on public /rastrear page - not verified in this iteration (contains check for 'JOAO DA SILVA' returned False, but 'CAMPO GRANDE' rendered correctly, so uppercase persistence is fine; visibility of that field on the public page is a product decision).
critical_code_review_comments: EntregaDialogs.jsx set() correctly applies toUpperCase for every key except status_atual and uses functional setForm to preserve focus caret across re-renders.
empty state now includes origem_cidade='DOURADOS' / origem_estado='MS' – defaults appear on Nova entrega and are reset properly via useEffect when the dialog re-opens.

AdminLogin uses <Navigate to='/admin' replace /> when user is set and navigate('/admin',{replace:true}) after login – both prevent /admin/login from staying in history, so mobile back never surfaces the login screen after auth.
AuthContext restores session from localStorage token via /auth/me on mount → F5 keeps session (verified).
seed_data_creation: Created one TESTUP##### entrega and deleted it after verifying public /rastrear rendered uppercase values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 confirmed: (a) origem defaults DOURADOS/MS pre-filled in Nova entrega; (b) auto-uppercase on form-codigo, form-destinatario, form-destino-cidade, form-destino-estado, form-localizacao, form-observacao AND mov-local/mov-observacao – input.value is uppercase and focus is preserved character-by-character (previous focus-loss bug from iter 2 stays fixed); (c) navigating to /admin/login while authenticated redirects to /admin without re-prompting; (d) F5 on /admin keeps the session; (e) public /rastrear/{codigo} renders values persisted uppercase (e.g. 'CAMPO GRANDE'); (f) create/delete flow works. Backend was not re-tested (still 15/15 from iter 1).
rca of the issue: Not applicable – all requested behaviors are implemented and verified.
